com.esignal.jstandard.utils

Class GreeksUtil

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.utils.GreeksUtil

  • public final class GreeksUtil
extends java.lang.Object
    This util class provides the methods to calculate the Greeks . The users can calculates Greeks using the Black-Scholes Model and the Binomial model. The user can also calculate the rolling average volatility and interpolated weighted average volatility using methods in this util class.

    Before invoking methods on this class you will have to instantiate the factory by calling: ResourceManagerFactory factory = ResourceManagerFactory.getFactory();

    Since:
    01-014-0000
    Author:
    Interactive Data
    See Also:
    GreeksException, DividendData, VolatilityOptionData

      • calculateOptionBlackScholes

        public static double calculateOptionBlackScholes(GreeksUtil.OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE type,
                                                 double stockBid,
                                                 double stockAsk,
                                                 double stockLast,
                                                 double optionBid,
                                                 double optionAsk,
                                                 double riskInterest,
                                                 double carry,
                                                 double strike,
                                                 double volatility,
                                                 int daysToMaturity,
                                                 GreeksUtil.PUT_CALL_INDICATOR putCallIndicator,
                                                 int flags)
                                          throws GreeksException
        Calculates Greeks using the Black-Scholes Model.
        Parameters:
        type - indicate the type of Greeks requested from OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE enum. (Example: OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.DELTA)
        stockBid - is the underlying stock's bid price.
        stockAsk - is the underlying stock's ask price.
        stockLast - is the underlying stock's last price.
        optionBid - is the option bid price.
        optionAsk - is the option ask price.
        riskInterest - is the risk interest rate (in percent). Risk rate is the reversal rate (short rate) and is typically around 70% of the carry (risk-free) rate. Calculate the risk interest as 0.7 * Carry rate.
        carry - is the carry rate. Carry rate is the risk-free interest rate and is usually equal to the current 13-week Treasury bill rate. Use the decimal form of the rate (rate/100). Example: For 2%, use 0.02.
        strike - is the option strike price.
        volatility - is the underlying stock's volatility (1-100). volatility cannot be 0 for the following OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE types: OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.THEORETICAL_VALUE OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.DELTA OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.GAMMA OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.THETA OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.VEGA OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.RHO
        daysToMaturity - is the number of days until this option expires.
        putCallIndicator - is the call or put indicator. Use PUT_CALL_INDICATOR
        flags - is the flag to indicate whether to use the bid or ask fields for the calculation.
        Returns:
        is the returned data.
        Throws:
        GreeksException - is the Exception returned in case of issues with the input .

        Calculates Greeks using the Binomial Model.
        Parameters:
        type - indicate the type of Greeks requested from OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE enum. (Example: OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.DELTA)
        stockBid - is the underlying stock's bid price.
        stockAsk - is the underlying stock's ask price.
        riskFreeInterest - is the carry rate. Carry rate is the risk-free interest rate and is usually equal to the current 13-week Treasury bill rate. Use the decimal form of the rate (rate/100). Example: For 2%, use 0.02.
        strike - is the tree depth. is the option strike price.
        volatility - is the underlying stock's volatility (1-100). volatility cannot be 0 for the following OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE types: OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.THEORETICAL_VALUE OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.DELTA OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.GAMMA OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.THETA OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.VEGA OPT_ANALYTICS_REQUEST_TYPE.RHO

      • calculateInterpolatedWeightedAverageVolatility

        public static double calculateInterpolatedWeightedAverageVolatility(double stockBid,
                                                                    double stockAsk,
                                                                    double stockLast,
                                                                    double optionBid,
                                                                    double optionAsk,
                                                                    double riskInterest,
                                                                    double carry,
                                                                    double strike,
                                                                    double volatility,
                                                                    int daysToMaturity,
                                                                    GreeksUtil.PUT_CALL_INDICATOR putCallIndicator,
                                                                    int flags)
                                                             throws GreeksException
        Calculates volatility using the closest strikes to the last price of the stock. This is the interpolated weighted average calculation.
        Parameters:
        stockBid - is the underlying stock's bid price.
        stockAsk - is the underlying stock's ask price.
        stockLast - is the underlying stock's last price.
        optionBid - is the option bid price.
        optionAsk - is the option ask price.
        riskInterest - is the risk interest rate (in percent). Risk rate is the reversal rate (short rate) and is typically around 70% of the carry (risk-free) rate. Calculate the risk interest as 0.7 * Carry rate.
        carry - is the carry rate. Carry rate is the risk-free interest rate and is usually equal to the current 13-week Treasury bill rate. Use the decimal form of the rate (rate/100). Example: For 2%, use 0.02.
        strike - is the closest strike from the Last of the underlyer. For example, if the Last price is $32 for VMW, the strike price used for calculating volatility should be 32.
        volatility - is the underlying stock's volatility (1-100).
        daysToMaturity - is the number of days until this option expires.
        putCallIndicator - is the call or put indicator. Use PUT_CALL_INDICATOR.
        flags - is the flag to indicate whether to use the bid or ask fields for the calculation.
        Returns:
        is the returned data.
        Throws:
        GreeksException - is the Exception returned in case of issues with the input .

      • calculateRollingAverageVolatility

        public static double calculateRollingAverageVolatility(double stockBid,
                                                       double stockAsk,
                                                       double riskInterest,
                                                       int daysToMaturity,
                                                       VolatilityOptionData[] optData)
                                                throws GreeksException
        Calculates volatility using the three closest strike prices to the last price of the stock. This is the rolling average calculation.
        Parameters:
        stockBid - is the underlying stock's bid price.
        stockAsk - is the underlying stock's ask price.
        riskInterest - is the risk interest rate (in percent). Risk rate is the reversal rate (short rate) and is typically around 70% of the carry (risk-free) rate. Calculate the risk interest as 0.7 * Carry rate.
        daysToMaturity - is the number of days until this option expires.
        optData - is the option put/call data for three closest strikes to the underlying stock's "Last" price.
        Returns:
        is the returned data.
        Throws:
        GreeksException - is the Exception returned in case of issues with the input .
